answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The horizon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pearl.
